instruction: Fix cross-request C02 starvation in the existing SynapticBrain pool. Timed-out optional core callbacks may still be running when the next pulse starts; submitting C02 first inside a pulse does not reserve capacity across pulses. Keep exactly the existing ThreadPoolExecutor and unchanged max_workers/max_inflight limits. Bound the total outstanding optional (non-C02) jobs across requests to max_workers - 1, using nonblocking admission, so at least one existing worker and inflight credit remain available for indexed S03 memory. Every completion/cancellation/submission-error path must release exactly its acquired credits; bind each callback to its own optional flag. With max_workers=1, optional groups get the existing explicit HOLD_QUEUE_SATURATED state and the single worker remains available for C02. Preserve C02-first scheduling, memory deadlines, required-memory holds, all eight output group entries, STOP/authorization, persona/scope filtering and the existing close behavior. Do not create another pool, process, service or model, increase budgets, remove S03 dependence, accept the parent, or modify tests.
